release.name: Bun v1.4.3
release.release_notes:
To install Bun v1.4.3
```bash
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
# or you can use npm
# npm install -g bun
```

Windows:
```bash
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1|iex"
```

To upgrade to Bun v1.4.3:
```bash
bun upgrade
```

### [Read Bun v1.4.3's release notes on Bun's blog](https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4.3)

### Thanks to 8 contributors!

headline_comparison.baseline_note: Ratios are the median challenged values of each runtime divided by the same values of the baseline runtime. A value below 1.0 means the runtime is cheaper/faster than the baseline.

method.cold_definition: Every extraction is a fresh yt-dlp process with a private HOME/XDG_*/TMPDIR, no cookie file, no user profile and no shared runtime cache.
method.control_note: The 'control_unchallenged' video is not guaranteed to stay unchallenged: YouTube sometimes challenges it too. per_runtime.<key>.control_unchallenged_clean therefore restricts the control to the runs that executed no solver script at all.
method.cpu_method: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) delta around each extraction; on Linux this is transitive, so the frozen yt-dlp's embedded CPython and the JS runtime child are both included.
method.description: Cold yt-dlp extractions per JS runtime on a challenged YouTube video plus two controls, serialized (one extraction at a time).
method.rss_method: Maximum sampled sum of process-tree RSS over the whole yt-dlp process tree; shared pages may be counted once per mapping process and short-lived spikes may be missed.

scenarios.description: challenged video with the web_embedded player client; the JS runtime is load-bearing here (a broken or missing runtime makes the extraction fail)
challenged video with the default player client, i.e. the exact production flag set; the runtime is still invoked by yt-dlp but the extraction can also succeed without it
unchallenged video, default player client; the runtime is only probed for its version unless YouTube decides to challenge this request

runtimes.upstream_status: above the pinned yt-dlp bun ceiling of 1.3.14 (yt-dlp 2026.08.19 warns but still invokes the runtime); measured with the unchanged CLI

upstream_sources.fact: deno >= 2.3.0, node >= 22.0.0, bun >= 1.2.11, quickjs >= 2023-12-9, all quickjs-ng versions supported.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp 2026.08.19 - yt_dlp/utils/_jsruntime.py (minimum supported runtime versions)

upstream_sources.fact: Provider preference: deno 1000, node 900, quickjs 850, bun 800. Bun is capped at 1.3.14 and deprecated. quickjs-ng below 0.12.0 is missing optimizations.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp 2026.08.19 - yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/jsc/_builtin/{deno,node,quickjs,bun}.py

upstream_sources.fact: Deno is the recommended runtime and is enabled by default; bun support is deprecated and versions after 1.3.14 are unsupported; quickjs-ng below 0.12.0 can take minutes per challenge.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp wiki - EJS: External JS Scripts Setup Guide

upstream_sources.fact: Public JS Challenge Provider API and the -v jsc_trace debugging switch.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp 2026.08.19 - yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/jsc/README.md

upstream_sources.fact: Source of truth for the bun gate, quoted verbatim: _BUN_MAX_SUPPORTED_VERSION = (1, 3, 14); is_unsupported_version = self.runtime_info.version_tuple > self._BUN_MAX_SUPPORTED_VERSION; the unsupported branch only logs 'bun version {v} is not supported! {max} is the last supported bun version. DO NOT open a bug report even if you encounter any errors!' and then continues into the same bun invocation; the supported branch logs 'bun support has been deprecated.'. The gate is therefore a warning, not a refusal to run.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp 2026.08.19 - yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/jsc/_builtin/bun.py (bun version gate)

upstream_sources.fact: BunJsRuntime.MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION = (1, 2, 11) and JsRuntimeInfo.supported = vt >= MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION. This is the only value that makes a runtime unavailable (EJSBaseJCP.runtime_info returns None when not runtime.info.supported), so a bun newer than 1.3.14 stays available to the bun challenge provider.
upstream_sources.title: yt-dlp 2026.08.19 - yt_dlp/utils/_jsruntime.py (BunJsRuntime.MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION)

upstream_sources.fact: Primary upstream statement: 'We rewrote Bun in Rust - and this is the first release'. Bun 1.4 is therefore the Rust rewrite of the runtime.
upstream_sources.title: Bun v1.4 release blog (Rust rewrite)
